subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: Should this PR land as a scoped embedded `sessions_spawn` mitigation while the broader fallback-completion invariant remains open for gateway, `sessions_send`/cron, and Codex-native spawn surfaces?
rationale: The patch is a plausible and proven scoped fix, but it deliberately chooses a fail-closed fallback policy for one work-spawning surface while leaving adjacent delegation paths uncovered; automation cannot choose that product/merge-risk boundary.

options.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
options.body: Rebase the branch, merge the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard, and keep the canonical issue open for the remaining delegation surfaces.

options.title: Harden More Surfaces First
options.body: Require this PR to add a shared policy seam or additional mechanical gates for `sessions_send`/cron or gateway loopback before merge.

options.title: Pause For Codex/OpenClaw Policy Design
options.body: Hold or close this branch until maintainers choose one cross-runtime policy for OpenClaw tools and Codex-native delegation.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, merge the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard, and keep the canonical issue open for the remaining delegation surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned and authored the review comment that set the cross-harness invariant and scope question.
